items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: it was his sense of melody really hit me hard. His — what’s the word — just his sense of melody and melodic development. That was a huge influence on me.

ctx.x: Did you hear in your formative years a particular tenor player that you became enamored of for some time?

I’ve gone through a lot of phases. I think my first, probably my first was Sonny Rollins. And I think the bridge for me from traditional to bebop or post-trad, I don’t know what you want to call the early Sonny stuff, but it was his sense of melody really hit me hard. His — what’s the word — just his sense of melody and melodic development. That was a huge influence on me. And also I think, who else, Lester Young was huge. I think at that time those two guys were really big for me, and really important for me.…
